g.aria-label: Analytical Tweedie Shrinkage on a Gaussian Mode N(μ, v I)
p_σ = N(μ, (v + σ²)I) ⇒ ∇log p_σ(x̃) = −(x̃ − μ) / (v + σ²)
Adding isotropic noise σ² inflates variance from v = s² to v + σ²
E[x₀ | x̃] = x̃ + σ² ∇log p_σ(x̃) = μ + [v / (v + σ²)](x̃ − μ)
At v = 0.25, σ = 0.3: shrinkage factor v/(v + σ²) = 0.735
Per-Coordinate MSE Drops from σ² = 0.090 to 0.066
In 2D (d = 2): point MSE drops from 0.180 to 0.132 (−27%)
Tweedie step x̃ + σ² s_θ(x̃) shrinks noisy points toward high-density mode centers
